title: GamePreview
responsibility: Run native key-door gameplay and preserve progress while keeping optional AI video disabled by default.

inputs.name: GamePreview.view
inputs.description: Game view defining geometry, checkpoints, rendering dimension and visual style.

inputs.name: GamePreview.initialRun
inputs.description: Optional saved gameplay state; without it a fresh run starts at the view spawn. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

inputs.name: GamePreview.projectId
inputs.description: Project identifier for rendering requests, or null when no project is open.

inputs.name: GamePreview.readonly
inputs.description: Prevents starting an AI video session when true; defaults to false. Gameplay movement and reset remain interactive, and run changes still reach onRun.

inputs.name: GamePreview.onRun
inputs.description: Receives each updated gameplay state so the workspace can retain progress.

inputs.name: GamePreview.bridge
inputs.description: Optional native bridge providing the authorized game rendering operation. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

outputs.name: GamePreview
outputs.description: Interactive 2D or 3D gameplay canvas, movement and reset controls, current run readout and optional AI video controls. A read-only preview explains that AI generation is disabled. Initial, movement and reset run snapshots are published through onRun.

errors.name: Renderer initialization or run callback error
errors.description: WebGL renderer initialization can fail when unavailable; errors from onRun propagate during initialization, reset or movement. AI video failures are caught and displayed.
